title: Argentinian Steak Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and savory stir fry dish featuring steak and a variety of vegetables, inspired by Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced argentinian steak and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the steak from the wok and set aside.
Add the sliced skirtly steak to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Add the mushrooms, bok choy, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger to the wok.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Return the cooked steak to the wok and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the steak is coated in the sauce.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
